summary.what_it_does: This is the program page for a panel at SREcon16 (Santa Clara, CA, April 2016) titled "Who/What Is SRE?". The panel was moderated by Jennifer Petoff of Google, with panelists from Pinterest, Dropbox, Google, Matterport, Netflix, and Facebook. The page lists the speakers and a BibTeX citation entry. It states that post-event video, audio, and slides are free under USENIX's open access policy. The page itself contains no panel transcript or summary of the discussion.
notable: Panel of SRE practitioners from six companies, moderated by a Google engineer
USENIX open access policy: post-event video, audio, and slides are free
caveats: SREcon16 was sold out and accepted no walkup registrations, per the page
The page has no discussion content or transcript, only speaker listing and citation
